copy.gary: I've been wandering Westminster parks and I still find something new on most visits, like the splash pad at Sigler Park on a hot afternoon or a pickleball game at Tony Lam Park.
copy.description: Check in at every Westminster, California park you visit, collect stamps and badges, rate your favorites and explore with your Park Pals.

motifs.name: Little Saigon
motifs.blurb: Westminster is home to Little Saigon, the largest Vietnamese community outside Vietnam.

motifs.name: Tết blossoms
motifs.blurb: Every Lunar New Year the city's Tết Parade fills the streets with music, dragons and yellow apricot blossoms.

motifs.name: Mendez v. Westminster
motifs.blurb: In 1946 the Mendez family won a federal case against Westminster's segregated schools, years before Brown v. Board of Education. Mendez Tribute Monument Park honors them.

motifs.name: Vietnam War Memorial
motifs.blurb: Sid Goldstein Freedom Park holds a memorial to the American and South Vietnamese soldiers of the Vietnam War, with their two flags side by side.

motifs.name: Sigler Park splash pad
motifs.blurb: On summer afternoons the splash pad at Sigler Park is the coolest place in town.

motifs.name: Liberty Skate Park
motifs.blurb: Liberty Park's skate park was built for beginner and intermediate skaters. Helmets and pads on, then drop in.

motifs.name: Pickleball
motifs.blurb: Sigler Park and Tony Lam Park both have pickleball courts, open from morning until 9 at night.

motifs.name: The Rose Center
motifs.blurb: The Rose Center is the city's own theater, with plays, concerts and community nights.
